key_provisions_or_claims: UNESCO and Bangladesh launched a three-day AI literacy and ethics training for civil servants in Dhaka, 15-18 June 2026.
UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology identified capacity development among officials as a key requirement for AI adoption.
Training delivered through UNESCO's AI Ethics Experts Without Borders network, with EU funding.
Supports implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
The Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority plans to use AI to enhance its e-GP system.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news article reporting a three-day AI literacy and ethics training for Bangladeshi civil servants and procurement officials, funded by the EU and based on UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology. It supports implementation of the UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation. General AI capacity-building; no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Government Strengthens Civil Service Capacity for Responsible AI Governance
annotation.title_en: Government Strengthens Civil Service Capacity for Responsible AI Governance
